record.paper_title: On chromatic numbers of space-times: open problems
record.original_question: For a real parameter α ≥ 1, replace the usual Minkowski temporal and spatial distances by the Busemann metrics τα(A, B) = ((a0 − b0)^α − (a1 − b1)^α − ... − (an − bn)^α)^(1/α) when the expression is nonnegative, and ρα(A, B) = ((a1 − b1)^α + ... + (an − bn)^α − (a0 − b0)^α)^(1/α) when the expression is nonpositive. Determine the corresponding chromatic-number behavior for these generalized space-time metrics.

evidence.quote: Case of Busemann space-time metrics. What if instead of the Minkowski definitions of τ (A, B) and ρ(A, B), we take a real number α ≥ 1 and consider more general Busemann metrics

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Fix integers $n\ge 1$ and a real parameter $\alpha \ge 1$. For points $A=(a_0,a_1,\dots,a_n)$ and $B=(b_0,b_1,\dots,b_n)$ in $\mathbb{R}^{n+1}$ (with $a_0,b_0$ regarded as the time coordinates), define the Busemann temporal pseudo-distance
$$\tau_\alpha(A,B) = \bigl((a_0-b_0)^\alpha - (a_1-b_1)^\alpha - \cdots - (a_n-b_n)^\alpha\bigr)^{1/\alpha},$$
defined whenever the quantity inside the outer parentheses is nonnegative, and the Busemann spatial pseudo-distance
$$\rho_\alpha(A,B) = \bigl((a_1-b_1)^\alpha + \cdots + (a_n-b_n)^\alpha - (a_0-b_0)^\alpha\bigr)^{1/\alpha},$$
defined whenever the quantity inside the outer parentheses is nonnegative.

For a fixed forbidden value $d>0$, let $\chi_{\tau_\alpha}(\mathbb{R}^{n+1};d)$ denote the chromatic number of the graph whose vertex set is $\mathbb{R}^{n+1}$ and whose edges join pairs $A,B$ with $\tau_\alpha(A,B)=d$ (and $\tau_\alpha$ defined); analogously define $\chi_{\rho_\alpha}(\mathbb{R}^{n+1};d)$ using $\rho_\alpha$.

Determine these chromatic numbers — or at least nontrivial upper and lower bounds for them — as functions of $n$ and $\alpha\ge 1$, and describe how the answers depend on $\alpha$ as it varies (in particular, what happens for $\alpha=2$, for $\alpha=1$, and for general $\alpha$).
artifact.status_search_result: A web search returns no results addressing chromatic numbers of space-time graphs equipped with Busemann-type metrics $\tau_\alpha,\rho_\alpha$ for general $\alpha\ge 1$. The question is posed as an open generalization of the Minkowski (α=2) case, and no published resolution was located.

status_evidence.snippet: Studies Busemann/Minkowski space geometry but does not treat chromatic numbers.
status_evidence.claim: No treatment of chromatic numbers for Busemann space-time metrics found.

status_evidence.title: A return to Euclid – The work of Herbert Busemann
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of Busemann's work on metric geometry; chromatic numbers are not discussed.
status_evidence.claim: No record of a solution to the chromatic-number question for $\tau_\alpha,\rho_\alpha$.
